facts.fact: TelOne opened a 120-rack, 400kW data centre at its Hillside exchange in Bulawayo, offering managed disaster recovery to banks, telcos, companies, government and IT providers.
TelOne says its Bulawayo Hillside data centre is Tier 3 designed with redundant power and cooling; operator statement, no certification mentioned.
TelOne opened a 34-rack data centre at the Mazowe Earth Station in March 2022, its fourth data centre.
